claim_boundary: One-case prefix-only competence smoke on the already-open single_lift_cloth source interaction. It can reject or admit a separately frozen nonlinear PhysTwin rerun, but cannot establish future improvement, calibration, independent transfer, or state of the art.
question: Can material-attached PhysTwin Gaussian appearance identify a low-rank graph-position correction from early response RGB that improves held-out response-prefix rendering without manual identities or future observations?

observation_model.material_attachment: fixed inverse-distance weights from every retained Gaussian to its 16 nearest frame-zero PhysTwin graph nodes
observation_model.skinning: Gaussian means receive the weighted graph-node displacement from frame zero; Gaussian rotation, scale, opacity, and spherical-harmonic appearance remain fixed
observation_model.graph_basis_source: frozen rank-4 basis from the prior matched state/discrepancy audit
observation_model.parameterization: 12 graph-position directions: rank-4 modes independently displaced along world x, y, and z

correlation_and_robustness.information_mass: fixed per frame and divided equally across usable cameras and occupied spatial blocks; pixel count does not increase total information
correlation_and_robustness.duplicate_camera_policy: a duplicated camera divides rather than adds camera information mass
correlation_and_robustness.robust_group_likelihood: Huber-style IRLS over spatial block residual RMS

prefix_gate.pass_action: Seal the prefix artifact, then preregister and implement a separate official-Warp position-and-velocity state-injection rerun. No future RGB or mask may be read.
prefix_gate.fail_action: Return exact zero graph weights and stop this Gaussian-attachment, translation-skinning, rank-4 parameterization without threshold, frame, camera, mask, attachment, or rank tuning.
